stats_client_component.title: an event that will exceed your expectations
stats_client_component.description2: Instead of the traditional triathlons, where the winner is the one who makes the smallest time, in TRITON 3 the game is different! Here, the champion is the one who sums up the least points over the three days. The score is defined by daily placement. This puts all modalities on the same footing and transforms the competition into a true test of consistency, strategy and resilience.

format_section.title: Innovation
format_section.subtitle: Formats that redefine the experience
format_section.description: The TRITON 3 is a race held over 3 consecutive days. An unique experience that elevates triathlon to another level. The format allows athletes, swimmers, cyclists, and runners to participate in the race individually.

day_1.title: Swimming
day_1.description: Held on the private beach of the Portobello Resort

day_2.title: Cycling
day_2.description: Held on the emblematic and challenging Serra do Piloto. The concentration of the race takes place at the Mangaratiba (EXPO) Exhibition Park

day_3.title: Running
day_3.description: Held within the Portobello condominium, this race starts from behind the resort heading to the safari. A cinematic route.

card_1.title: TRIATHLON
card_1.description: Your final ranking position (after the three days) will be the sum of your classification in each modality: Swimming + Cycling + Running.

card_2.title: RELAY (Corporate)
card_2.description: Form your team (duo or trio). Each one does one modality. In case of a duo, an athlete will have to do more than one modality.

card_3.title: INDIVIDUAL
card_3.description: Choose between swimming, cycling and/or running, define the distance and sign up!
card_3.advise: Does not score for the final ranking (3 days), but competes for daily awards by modality.

locations_section.title: SECURE YOUR REGISTRATION
locations_section.subtitle: AUG 21, 22, 23
locations_section.description: The entire event structure is located within the Portobello Resort & Safári. Both the hotel and the event are subject to maximum capacity. Secure your spot as soon as possible and live this immersive experience!

banner.title: TRANSFORMING PARADISE INTO YOUR PROVING GROUND
banner.description: Relive the best moments of TRITON 3 2025 and get ready to experience this unique event that challenges your body and renews your mind.

resort.title: Portobello Resort
resort.description: It is the official event hotel and offers exclusive conditions for TRITON athletes and their families:
resort.list_1: Special Rate with all meals included
resort.list_2: Free for 2 children up to 7 years old

other_options.title: Other Options
other_options.description: Staying at the official event hotel is not mandatory. There are other accommodation options in the Mangaratiba region.
